title: Beatrix and the Terminal
author: Freya Pemberton
blurb: Casper Eriksen, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
